## Architecture — Layer Inventory

Format Factory is organized into 11 independent layers, each with defined responsibilities and contracts.

| Layer | Name | Purpose | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| L01 | Specification Authority Layer (SAL) | Extracts machine-readable facts from format specifications | 30 |
| L02 | QName Registry | Maps spec element names to canonical class names | 21 |
| L03 | Capability Layer | Tracks per-format capability status and gap ledger | 126 |
| L05 | Oracle Layer | Deterministic verification against spec-derived test cases | 48 |
| L06 | Product Source | Parser, writer, and model implementations per format | 1685 |
| L07 | Test Layer | Unit, integration, roundtrip, and security tests | 10908 |
| L08 | Evidence Layer | Sprint evidence declarations and review packages | 9700 |
| L09 | State Layer | Continuation signals, plan locks, action queues | 56348 |
| L11 | Supervisor Layer | Autonomous sprint orchestration and grading | 503 |
| L12 | Governance Layer | Programmatic governance enforcement (validators) | 14 |
| L13 | Skills Layer | Registered skill catalog and command routing | 104 |

## Agent Ecosystem

Format Factory development is orchestrated by AI agents operating under a governed contract. All shipped library code is pure, deterministic, and contains no LLM calls at runtime.

### Agent Roles

| Agent | Role | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | Primary development executor | Configured |
| Codex | Secondary executor with governance adapter | Adapter present |
| Kilo | Specialized orchestration | Configured |
| Supervisor | Autonomous sprint orchestration and grading | Active |

### Orchestration Model

- **Skill-first execution**: All product work routes through registered skills (102 registered)
- **Commands**: 101 command files in `.claude/commands/`
- **Supervisor tools**: 199 Python modules in `tools/supervisor/`
- **Max iterations per loop**: 12
- **Checkpoint interval**: Every N/A sprints
- **Supervisor authority**: Advisory only (repo is final authority)

### Decision Boundaries

| Decision | Authority |
|---|---|
| Product implementation | Agent-owned (via registered skills) |
| Test execution | Agent-owned |
| Evidence declaration | Agent-owned |
| Sprint grading | Supervisor (automated) |
| Git commit | SCM Agent (sprint policy must authorize) |
| Git push | Requires credentials + explicit policy |
| Gate 1-10 approval | Agent-owned (evidence-based) |
| Gate 11 execution | Human required (Babar Raza) |
| Package publication | Requires credentials |
